extract:
Melee Influence is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that grants melee  Electricity status procs a 20% chance to grant a timed buff that causes melee elemental status effects to spread to enemies around the targeted enemy. The buff cannot have its duration refreshed.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing The Fragmented on Effervo, Deimos.
Awarded for killing Whispers in Albrecht's Laboratories missions.
Awarded for killing Gruzzlings in non-Disruption Albrecht's Laboratories mission.
Can be bought from Bird 3 of Cavia for  7,500, requiring Rank 4 - Scholar.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Eligible status effects that can be spread by Melee Influence include:
Primary Elemental ( Cold,  Electricity,  Heat,  Toxin)
Secondary Elemental ( Blast,  Corrosive,  Gas,  Magnetic,  Radiation,  Viral)
Melee Influence cannot spread the following:
Physical ( Impact,  Puncture,  Slash)
 Void,  Tau,  Knockdown,  Stagger,  Ragdoll,  Lifted, and  Microwave
When an elemental Status Effect is spread by Melee Influence, affected enemies are also dealt damage equal to that element's damage from the original attack.
Example: When a melee attack that deals 100 physical base damage modded with  Shocking Touch and  Magnetic Rush procs Magnetic, every other enemy within Melee Influence's range will receive 60 Magnetic damage and a Magnetic status effect.
Damage spread is based on the amount of matching elemental damage after quantization, including effects such as  Condition Overload and critical multiplier.
For damage spread by Melee Influence, Condition Overload's damage bonus is based on the number of status effects on the target directly struck by the attack that caused Melee Influence damage to be spread; the number of status effects on the enemies receiving Melee Influence damage is not part of the calculation.
Performing a finisher with a forced elemental proc will not spread any Finisher damage, as 0% of the damage dealt is made up of the elemental status that was procced.
Spread radius extends from the position of the enemy hit.
Thrown weapons like  Xoris and gunblades like  Redeemer greatly benefit from this
Melee Influence only triggers from direct melee strikes. Secondary melee effects such as  Magnetic's breakage effect and  Dual Ichor Incarnon's toxin fields cannot trigger Melee Influence.
Melee projectiles passing through  Electric Shield,  Mutalist Quanta's alternate fire, or  Conductive Sphere can also trigger Melee Influence.
Does not work with Glaive (Weapon Type) weapons
Examples of this are  Nepheri,  Hate Incarnon Genesis,  Ceramic Dagger Incarnon Genesis, or  Syam's projectiles.
Proccing multiple elements at the same time will show the sum of the spread damage.
Due to the nature of Faction Damage Bonuses, they are applied twice on damage done by Melee Influence and thrice on damaging status procs caused by it.
A melee with 100 base damage modded with  Shocking Touch and with a 55% Increased Faction Damage Bonus, will deal 294 Hit damage, with a 228 Electricity Proc Damage. If Melee Influence procs, the spread Electricity procs will deal 353 damage.
Examples: A  Skana modded with  Pressure Point,  Vicious Frost,  Virulent Scourge, and  Voltaic Strike.
A hit that procs  Electricity will do 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (0.6) = 158.4  Electricity damage to all enemies in range and apply an  Electricity proc dealing 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (1 + 0.6) ÷ 2 = 211.2  Electricity damage per tick.
A hit that procs  Viral will do 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (0.6 + 0.6) = 316.8  Viral damage to all enemies in range and apply a  Viral proc.
A hit that procs  Slash will do nothing.
A hit that procs  Electricity and  Viral will do 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (0.6) = 158.4  Electricity damage and 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (0.6 + 0.6) = 316.8  Viral damage to all enemies in range, then apply a  Viral proc and an  Electricity proc dealing 120 × (1 + 1.2) × (1 + 0.6) ÷ 2 = 211.2  Electricity damage per tick.
The AoE ignores the Rift Plane, affecting all enemies within range regardless of what plane the attack was made from.
Elemental damage gained through abilities such as  Smite Infusion will also be spread by Melee Influence.

Tips
It can sometimes be strategic to focus on only one elemental type, since adding additional types makes it less likely for your weapon's highest elemental damage type to trigger. But it can also be strategic to use multiple elemental types; for example, Viral procs can multiply the damage of subsequent Eletric procs, and more types of status procs means increased damage bonuses from Condition Overload.

Weapons With Forced Electric Procs
Weapons that have a chance or guaranteed electricity status effect independent of weapon elemental damage types, that can activate Melee Influence. Note that slam attacks include any melee stance combo that also results in a slam attack.

 Prova/ Prova Vandal: Slam attacks (100% chance) and  Static Discharge (chance)
 Xoris: In-flight detonation (100%)
 Falcor: In-flight detonation and charged throw (100%)
 Arca Titron: Slam attacks (chance), Slam Capacitor slam attacks (100%) and Heavy slam attacks (100%)
 Obex/ Prisma Obex: Slam attacks (chance)
 Ohma/ Prisma Ohma: Slam attacks (chance)
 Lacera/ Ceti Lacera: Slam attacks (chance)
 Galvacord: Slam attacks (chance)
 Rumblejack: Slam attacks (100%), Heavy slam attacks (chance)
Unique finisher cannot proc Melee Influence
 Lecta/ Secura Lecta: Slam attacks (chance), Heavy slam attacks (chance)
 Ninkondi: Slam attacks (chance), Heavy slam attacks (chance)
 Korumm: Unique block combo (100%)

Bugs
The following non-melee weapons and precepts can trigger Melee Influence:
 Electro Pulse
 Synergized Prospectus only on clients.
While Melee Influence is active, a  Cold  Elemental Ward will count reflected bullet damage as melee damage, reflecting  Cold procs to surrounding enemies who shoot at you.
Hits that one-hit-kill enemies cannot trigger nor benefit from Melee Influence.
Decrees can also use Melee Influence's effect. These Decrees are of note:
 Wyrmling's Aid
